stem: Which sentence from “Prince Patrick” shows that Patrick begins to feel the same way?
instruction:
Read this sentence from “A Wintry Welcome.”

I almost forgot about Texas as I concentrated on my new friends instead.

options.label: A
options.text: "This is not how I imagined I would be spending Saturday afternoon," he thought.

options.label: B
options.text: Patrick didn’t even know how to braid hair.

options.label: C
options.text: The girls chatted about Patrick’s work as they positioned shimmering crowns on their heads.

options.label: D
options.text: "Might as well make this fun," he thought.

visual_elements: I almost forgot about Texas as I concentrated on my new friends instead.
